<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectPreferences</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChoosePostFarmActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarmSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarmJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Finished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingEvents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ListUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContinueFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Player wants a custom farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPreferences" name="Select resources and preferences">
      <bpmn:documentation>Select up to 10 resources to farm in parallel, set their relative urgency, and define tool and resource dependencies for the custom farming logic.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start farming"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_FarmingEvents" name="Wait for a farming event" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ListUpdate" name="Farming list updated">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_ListUpdate">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The player updates the list of materials to be farmed</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_NaturalDisaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A random natural disaster strikes</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Milestone" name="Milestone reached">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A farming milestone is reached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FarmingComplete" name="Farming completed">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_FarmingComplete">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The bot has finished farming</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to be farmed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply disaster setback to the bot"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmingMerge" name="Resume farming"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueFarming" name="Continue farming according to preferences and dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChoosePostFarmActions" name="Choose post-farming actions and selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" name="Choose one or both actions" default="Flow_NoPostFarmAction"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" name="Complete selected actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Finished" name="Post-farming actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Select" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_StartFarming" sourceRef="Task_SelectPreferences" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartFarming_Events" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Update" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_ListUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Disaster" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_NaturalDisaster"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Milestone" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_FarmingComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task" sourceRef="Event_ListUpdate" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Merge" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Task" sourceRef="Event_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Task" sourceRef="Event_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Continue" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingMerge" targetRef="Task_ContinueFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue_Events" sourceRef="Task_ContinueFarming" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complete_Choose" sourceRef="Event_FarmingComplete" targetRef="Task_ChoosePostFarmActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_Split" sourceRef="Task_ChoosePostFarmActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Bragging is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Send" name="Send materials selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Sending materials is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPostFarmAction" name="No post-farming action selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Finished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
